utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details; what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still aiming for Saturday morning, and I’m checking with the others about the tools and truck.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—Saturday morning still works for me. Let me know when the tools and truck are confirmed, and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the supply list and tool check, and I’ll keep track of who’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Mara — thanks for keeping tabs on the helpers. I’ll note the supplies and where everything should go at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’ll keep tracking the helpers and see if we still need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure both groups know the repair drive starts at the community center and runs through Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got the screws, paint, and a couple hammers already. Let me know if you still need anything picked up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — that covers a lot. If you can grab any extra nails and a screwdriver set, that would be a big help, and I’ll keep both groups posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’m still gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive. If you hear of anything usable, let me know and I can swing by to pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m happy to help once the tools are ready. Just tell me the meeting spot and I’ll be there, even if I’m a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’ll send the meeting spot as soon as it’s set, and I’ll keep gathering the tools and parts in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great, Bo — I’ve got the screws, paint, and hammers noted. If Kira hears of any spare tools or hardware, send them my way and I’ll keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still on for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — we’re still on, and I’m keeping the supply list updated. If you hear of any spare tools or hardware, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard the final schedule yet, Gus, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — appreciate you keeping tabs. Once the schedule’s locked, just send it my way and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Gus — I’ll send it right over the moment I hear it. We’re all set, just waiting on the final word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 still works for me—I can keep it brief and meet right after pickup. I’ll send the details and what needs doing once I’ve checked them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — 3:30 works for me. Just send the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send everything over once I’ve checked it. Thanks for being flexible around pickup — I’ll keep it brief so we stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m set for 9:00 Saturday by the community shed, and I’ll bring my gloves and a hammer if I can find one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that helps. I’m still waiting to confirm the tools and drop-off plan, but once that’s locked in I’ll send the schedule and what everyone should bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll wait for the final schedule and tool list. Just let me know the place, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we’re meeting at 10 by the community shed, and I’ll bring the screwdriver set and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — that sounds good to me. I’ll keep things simple and be there at 10 by the shed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you then — thanks for keeping me on track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll be there at 9 with the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep an ear out for any spare tools or hardware and pass them along. Thanks for the update!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. I’ll see you at 9.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 3:30 works for me too. I’ll bring the tools and keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word that we’re set for 3:30 and that you’re bringing the tools. Thanks, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—see you at 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the time and a short list of supplies today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — I’ll keep the list tidy and share it with everyone once it’s in. That’ll help us keep the repair drive running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — thanks, Rosa. I’ll send the details today, and if you notice anything missing, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m a little late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — Mina’s coordinating the list, and I’m happy to help with whatever’s still needed. If you’re free, just tell me what time you’re coming and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I’m free in about 20 minutes, and I can help at the tool table or sort parts once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, who’s handling the tools and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Ira’s gathering the tools and spare parts, and we’re meeting at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — Ira has the tools, and we’re meeting at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — I’m sending the time and supply list today. If you can, please let me know what tools you already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what tools we already have and let you know today. Thanks for sending the time and supply list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. I’ll send the details later today, and if you spot anything we’re missing, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m on the supply list and tools, and I’ll keep track of who’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — 3:30 still works for me, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — 3:30 works, and thanks for bringing the tools. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if we’re missing anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so that helps a lot. I’ll keep an ear out for any spare tools or hardware and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check on that, but I still don’t have the tools or the meeting spot confirmed yet. I’d feel better once both are set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll keep asking around for the tools and meeting spot, and I’ll pass along anything I hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — that sounds perfect. Keep it simple, and I’ll see everyone around 10.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and tell folks we’re starting at 10 by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — that works perfectly. I appreciate you keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s still on, but I’m waiting for the final details before I confirm anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll hold off until you’ve got the final details. Once you confirm, I can help fill in any gaps and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll send the final details as soon as I have them, and then we can fill any gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll send over the repair drive details and what needs doing, and I’ll keep it tight around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Faye — send the details when you can, and I’ll keep the supply list updated. I’m already tracking screws, paint, and hammers, so I’ll note anything else that comes in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a big help. I’ll send the details soon, and if you can keep the list updated, I can make sure we stay quick and clear around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard the final schedule yet, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — appreciate you keeping an ear out. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll share any updates as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, thanks Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll spread the word. Keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I’m mostly gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything to donate, I can swing by and pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’ve got a screwdriver set and some work gloves you can pick up if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would help a lot, Oren — I can swing by and grab them while I’m out. Just let me know the best time to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along and make sure Rey has the time, place, and what to bring. Once you send the final details, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll be ready once the final details come through.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send Rey the final time, place, and supplies as soon as they’re locked in, then I’ll spread the word. Thanks for being ready to help!
